items.title: Gustave Fayet: Collector – Designer. Icons of Modern Art

items.text: By the time he graduated from the Lycée with a baccalauréat in literature in 1853, at age 18, he had turned a room in his home into an artist's studio
Degas duly enrolled at the Faculty of Law of the University of Paris in November 1853 but applied little effort to his studies
